notes.title: SxSW Showcase!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890203/f2b993eacf883f3eeacd5b0b38fb6090c69bf38c.png[/img]

[b]Hey everyone! [/b]

Sorry for the break—I’ve been busy showcasing Sun is Dead at the SXSW ATX Game Makers showcase! The feedback has been incredible—players are loving the combat, and I think I’ve finally nailed it. Now, I’m shifting focus to the narrative, and I can’t wait to bring new ideas to life based on everyone’s feedback. Stay tuned for more updates!
